title: Cosmic Portrait of Contemplation
description: A woman in classical golden attire and an elegant updo stands in left profile, gazing right. She is surrounded by numerous glossy dark blue spheres of varying sizes floating against a vibrant, swirling cosmic background of red, orange, purple and pink with dynamic fiery brushstrokes.
prompt: A classical woman in a golden toga with elegant updo hairstyle shown in left profile, surrounded by many floating glossy dark blue spheres and bubbles of different sizes, set against a dynamic swirling cosmic background of vibrant red orange purple and pink with energetic fiery brushstrokes exploding across the composition, surreal symbolic painting style, rich colors, dramatic lighting
